name: Integration - API Key Validation for OpenAI
description: Ensures that the Config class raises a ValueError if the OpenAI API key is missing when OpenAI is the provider.
input: Environment variable LLM_PROVIDER set to 'openai' and OPENAI_API_KEY unset.
output: ValueError is raised indicating missing OPENAI_API_KEY.
error_scenarios: No error is raised when API key is missing
